judgement.reason: The Go build stage needs the TARGETARCH build argument, which has no default, and it exits when the value is empty; the shown lines do not prove whether the Deployz build sets it.

evidence.quote: RUN case "${TARGETARCH}" in amd64) GOARCH=amd64 ;; arm64) GOARCH=arm64 ;; *) echo "Unsupported arch: ${TARGETARCH}" && exit 1 ;; esac && \
